title: Junction box lid gasket
prompt: Gasket for a junction box lid, laser cut from 1.5 mm rubber sheet. Outside 90 x 70 mm, 8 mm wide all round (so the opening is 74 x 54), with an M3 clearance hole (3.4 mm) in each corner, centred in the 8 mm band.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
90 x 70 mm outside, 1.5 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
Five cut-outs: the 74 x 54 opening and four screw holes
Four M3 clearance holes on an 82 x 62 mm rectangle (centred in the band)
